[SWS_Dlt_00780] ⌈The sending of Dlt messages via the PduR API shall be decoupled
from the Dlt_SendLogMessage and Dlt_SendTraceMessage API call.⌋
Note: The decoupling is done because of the following reasons:
• Shortening runtime of calls from the SW-Cs/BSWs which trigger log/trace mes-
sages, to reduce blocking time.
• In case traffic shaping functionality is enabled, the transmissions have to be pro-
cessed by an asynchronous cyclic BSW entity anyway.
• In case retry feature is enabled a decoupled BSW entity, which cares for retries,
is needed anyway.
